name: Ken Ma Ryou Joku
source:
Our hero Itsuki is the most average joe you could ever expect to meet. On the last train of the night, he dozes off. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a mysterious forest he has never seen before.
As Itsuki wanders about the forest looking for a way out, he stumbles on a lady warrior who has been trapped by a slime monster. Evidently, this is not present day. This is a world of fantasy and heroism like the ones you get in games or anime!
Many women have been captured by orcs, goblins and even fairies, becoming their playthings. Can Itsuki save them all?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032464.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角樹是個隨處可見的普通人。某天搭乘末班列車時，他不知不覺睡著了；一覺醒來，竟身處一片從未見過的神秘森林。

樹在森林中尋找出口，偶然撞見一名被史萊姆怪物困住的女戰士。這裡顯然不是現代社會，而是一個如同遊戲或動畫般充滿幻想與英雄冒險的世界！

許多女人被半獸人、哥布林，甚至妖精俘獲，淪為它們的玩物。樹能否把所有人救出來？

[內容取自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE032464.html]英文版DLsite[/url]]
